security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately uses BrowserAct network APIs and a BrowserAct API key. Most markdown backtick and system reconnaissance alerts are false positives. The main issue is unsafe guidance that asks users to provide an API key directly to the agent.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions to provide the key to the agent. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through the execution environment or a secret manager only.
Document that keywords, upload filters, task ids, and task output are exchanged with api.browseract.com before the script runs.
Tell agents to pass keywords and upload dates as separate arguments, with proper quoting for user-provided values.

content.user_title: Extract YouTube Channel Data with BrowserAct
content.value_statement: Manual YouTube channel research is slow and hard to standardize. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to return structured channel details from keyword searches.
actual_capabilities: Runs scripts/youtube_channel_api.py with search keywords and an optional upload date filter.
Starts a BrowserAct workflow template for YouTube channel search.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion, failure, cancellation, or timeout.
Returns channel fields such as title, link, handle, subscribers, verification, description, and thumbnail.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment for API authentication.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key before it can run.
Depends on BrowserAct service availability and workflow template behavior.
Does not analyze video content or audience demographics beyond returned channel fields.
Polls for up to five minutes and may return an error on long-running tasks.

use_cases.title: Creator Prospecting
use_cases.description: A partnerships manager finds YouTube channels in a niche and reviews public channel details for outreach.

use_cases.title: Competitor Channel Mapping
use_cases.description: A marketing analyst collects competitor-related channels and compares handles, subscriber counts, and descriptions.

use_cases.title: Research Dataset Building
use_cases.description: A data researcher gathers structured channel profiles from repeat keyword searches for a creator database.

prompt_templates.title: Find channels by topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find YouTube channels about home automation. Use Any time for upload date.

prompt_templates.title: Filter recent channel activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube channels for cybersecurity education that published content This week. Return the channel names, links, and subscriber counts.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitor categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for YouTube channels related to electric bike reviews. Organize results by apparent brand, independent creator, and media outlet.

prompt_templates.title: Build a research-ready shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Run searches for AI coding tutorials, developer tools, and software testing. Create a deduplicated shortlist with links, handles, subscribers, and notes.

output_examples.input: Find YouTube channels about plant-based cooking.
output_examples.output: A table-ready list of channel names, channel links, handles, subscriber counts, verification status, descriptions, and thumbnail links.

output_examples.input: Search for robotics channels that posted this week.
output: Current status messages while the BrowserAct task runs.
A final channel list when the task finishes.
A clear error message if authorization or polling fails.

output_examples.input: Build a shortlist of channels for fintech influencer outreach.
output_examples.output: A concise shortlist with public channel details that can be reviewed before outreach or CRM entry.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment before running the skill.
Use focused keywords so the returned channel list matches the research goal.
Review returned public data before adding channels to outreach or research workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or task prompts.
Do not run broad keyword searches when a niche query would be more accurate.
Do not treat subscriber counts as complete audience quality analysis.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY so the script can authenticate with BrowserAct.

faq.question: Does it scrape YouTube directly?
faq.answer: No. It calls a BrowserAct workflow template that performs the channel search workflow.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return channel title, link, handle, verification status, subscribers, description, and thumbnail URL.

faq.question: Can it filter by upload date?
faq.answer: Yes. The script accepts an optional upload date value such as Any time or This week.

faq.question: How long can a task run?
faq.answer: The script polls for up to five minutes before reporting a timeout.

faq.question: Can I use it for outreach research?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the results as a public channel shortlist and verify details before outreach.
